baseline: Previous n2+relativeMip+parent cellfit colour, replayed by native evaluator.
target_interpretation: C is O+clip(distance_inside(common replacement mask)/10,0,1)*(B-O): state-shared encoded-sRGB desired full image, view-dependent mask weights and per-query real O anchors. B retains the190-nonHELD shared atlas; C itself is not a pure world-consistent atlas projection. HELD9 O enters evaluation-target construction only, not the material fit. CPU source/contract audit verified against the actual manifest SHA, with same-scene exposure limitations.

limitations: C adds same-view real RGB inside replace; target-vs-O error reduction is largely by construction, not independent fusion evidence.
HELD9 C-target fidelity is query-RGB conditioned even inside replace; only the native3D render remains excluded from current HELD9 fitting.
Image-mask distance weights are view-dependent; do not claim a purely shared world-atlas target or isolate Poisson as the cause of an improvement.
The one C400-pair bake must be evaluated independently at identical fixed masks/parameters/budget; no legacy-static update or geometry change is allowed.

evidence_limits: Same-scene development; original key5 mask bytes preserved, remaining44 masks fixed by original measurements only.
Primary raw128 approximate user bbox and secondary world patch retain separate denominators.
Unsupported edge is None, never zero; incomplete target bins retain registered denominator and are not silently pooled.
Gaussian alpha/expected centre depth are not opaque first-hit measurements; fixed C2-ground ray categories have unknown hidden truth.
HELD9 excludes current target-source/fitting when contract confirms, but inherited prior scene/assets were previously exposed; not independent end-to-end test.
